lines.t: For I am the Lord, He who stretched out the heavens
And hung the earth upon nothing
And I am He who created all these worlds
He who causes all things to be
And I am He who formed man from the dust of the earth
And gave Him breath
And He became a living soul
Behold, I spoke all life into existence
Yes, I am
You called all things into existence
Sing and arise
And declare my glory
For all creation obeys the sound of my voice
Yeah, the whole universe declares my glory
For I am
For I am
For I am He who commanded the stars to shine their light
And the galaxies to take their form
Behold my voice reach across the universe
And reverence is spread out before me
For I command the hills to bow down
And the mountains to be brought low
And it is so
Yeah, the whole earth trembles when I pass by
For I am great in power and my glory has no equal
Thus the fear of the Lord goes before me
And obedience follows after me
Says the Lord
Thanks for watching!
Thank you.
